{"predictors": [
{"name": "Research and Development Efficiency", "construction": "Calculate the 3-year average of research and development expenses divided by the 3-year average of sales, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms that efficiently allocate research and development expenses may experience higher future growth and returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Corporate Governance Index", "construction": "Create an index based on the presence or absence of certain corporate governance provisions, such as staggered boards, poison pills, and golden parachutes, using data from Investor Responsibility Research Center (IRRC)", "rationale": "Firms with stronger corporate governance may have lower agency costs and higher future returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Industry Adjustment for Capital Expenditures", "construction": "Calculate the difference between a firm's capital expenditures and the average capital expenditures of its industry, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms that invest more in capital expenditures than their industry average may experience higher future growth and returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Stock Option Expense", "construction": "Calculate the 3-year average of employee stock option expenses divided by the 3-year average of total expenses, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with high employee stock option expenses may experience lower future returns due to the potential for overcompensation of employees", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Intangible Asset Ratio", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of intangible assets to total assets, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with high intangible assets may experience higher future growth and returns due to the potential for innovation and competitive advantage", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Plan Funding Status", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of pension plan assets to pension plan liabilities, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with well-funded pension plans may experience lower future returns due to the potential for lower financial distress", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Efficiency", "construction": "Calculate the 3-year average of cost of goods sold divided by the 3-year average of sales, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms that efficiently manage their supply chains may experience higher future growth and returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Performance Index", "construction": "Create an index based on environmental performance metrics, such as toxic emissions and environmental fines, using data from the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA)", "rationale": "Firms with strong environmental performance may experience higher future returns due to the potential for reduced regulatory risk and improved reputation", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Labor Productivity Growth", "construction": "Calculate the 3-year average growth rate of sales per employee, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with high labor productivity growth may experience higher future growth and returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Geographic Diversification Index", "construction": "Create an index based on the number of countries in which a firm operates, using data from Compustat and other sources", "rationale": "Firms with high geographic diversification may experience higher future returns due to the potential for reduced country-specific risk and increased growth opportunities", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
